firstPlayerRule: In the standard game, the oldest player goes first. Play then continues clockwise.
houseFallback: Choose randomly between players tied for oldest.
clarifications: In the auction version, the oldest player opens the first bidding. The highest bidder takes the first turn; if everyone passes, the first player to pass takes that turn for free.
